name: flik
description: Manage and optimize your Flik point-of-sale business from Claude: sales and profit reports, stock and reordering, pricing and margins, client debt (fiado), expenses, and a /pos cashier pane to sell from Claude Code.

scanFromPrompt.title: Scan barcodes at the prompt
scanFromPrompt.description: Treat a barcode-shaped message typed at the prompt (digits only, as a keyboard-wedge scanner sends) as a scan: open /pos and add the product instead of sending it to Claude.

barcodePattern.title: Barcode pattern
barcodePattern.description: Regex a scan must match. The default covers EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13 and ITF-14; widen it if your scanner adds a prefix or suffix.
